# LS Fencing & Metal Work

> Fence, gate and metal-work contractor serving residential and commercial projects in the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland, British Columbia. Confirm project scope and availability directly with LS Fencing.

Phone: 604-758-0014
Email: lsfencingandmetalwork@gmail.com
Website: https://lsfencingandmetalwork.com
